Welcome! This is the meeting place of Reborn's Geography Club! Fascinating, is it not?
Welcome! This is the meeting place of Reborn's History Club! Isn't it wonderful?
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Opal Ward?
The Opal Ward is right in the heart of Reborn City! It's one of the busiest wards, often bustling with Trainers and pedestrians alike!
Opal Bridge, the walkway between the lower-level of the ward and the Obsidia Ward in itself, is a renowned battling location!
New Trainers show up there for challenges all the time, so always be on your guard!
Of course, should you need to heal, simply stroll down to the Grand Hall! One of the largest buildings in Reborn, and the only one in Opal!
The Grand Hall has its own center, mart, and is generally a hub for the Reborn League. 'Tis a great place!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Obsidia Ward?
The Obsidia Ward is Reborn's largest ward, oftentimes considered in two separate halves, the main and south area, and North Obsidia.
Of course, we're in North Obsidia now, but the two halves have even been cut off from each other after the recent earthquakes. Oh my!
After all, underneath the Obsidia Ward is a network of railway tunnels. When the earthquakes hit, the hollow foundation gave way!
Not only is the tunnel unusable, but much of the ward was destroyed, including the HQ of Reborn's largest company, Yureyu!
While North Obsidia features the massive Grand Stairway, a monument leading outside the city,
Central Obsidia is now the prime commercial district.  There are salons, shops, and even a beautiful park all along Main Street!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Onyx Ward?
The Onyx Ward is one of the finest residential wards in the city. This may perhaps be because of its close location to the Onyx Trainers' School!
More than just a school, it also doubles as a Reborn League Gym! Young Trainers of all kinds flock there for their own reasons!
Between that and the Onyx Arcade, the Onyx Ward is one of the most youthful and lively places in the city!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Peridot Ward?
The Peridot Ward is the second largest in the city!  More than any other, however, it's also primarily an industrial ward.
Factories and warehouses line its shores of Azurine Lake... Many lower-income people live there too!
Unfortunately, as a result, the Peridot Ward has become notorious for homelessness and gang activity...
On a lighter note, the Power Plant and Reborn League Gym is also located there, not far from the Peridot Station, the best way in and out of Reborn!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Jasper Ward?
Bordering the peaceful Malchous Forest, the Jasper Ward is a very moderate residential area.
Many families of middle class live there- or... I should correct, did until quite recently...
With the recent overexpansion of the Malchous Forest, Jasper has become somewhat of a ruin, sadly...
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Lapis Ward?
The Lapis Ward is one of the highest-class in Reborn!
Perhaps rivaled only by the Onyx Ward, it's an ideal place for a family, with some of the lowest crime rates in the city!
It's also one of the few locations unaffected by recent disasters...
Most notable in the Lapis Ward are a Reborn League Gym and Dr. Connal's Orphanage. You can hardly miss them!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Beryl Ward?
Bordering the Rhodochrine Jungle, the Beryl Ward is among the larger wards in Reborn.
Although the recent disaster has spelled an end for much of its residence, Beryl was formerly a very unique middle-class community.
It also held a reputation of being one of the sightseeing places in the city, as it is the highest-up ward!
It offers great views of the Tourmaline Desert, Reborn City, and even the Azurine Region!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Coral Ward?
The Coral Ward is the smallest ward of Reborn, tucked into the corner of the Azurine Lake near South Obsidia.
Its main attraction has been its port! Coral is normally a very lively location full of hard workers and tourists traveling the lake!
Unfortunately, thanks to the recent water quality, there's been little need to go down there...
Interested in learning about Reborn's geography!  Splendid!
I'll give you one quick tip! Often times we refer to places, for instance the Azurine Region, just so, with the word 'Region'.
While it may be confusing to some, this use of the word 'Region' varies from that of places like the Hoenn Region, Kanto Region, or Reborn Region.
When we talk about regions here, think of them more as sub-regions, as they are all places within the greater Reborn Region!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Chrysolia Region?
Much of Chrysolia is an old forest, formerly connecting Reborn City and the Orre Region!
Other landmarks include the quaint Spinel Town, and the Tanzan Mountain area, a network of sprawing trails and caves!
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Azurine Region?
The Azurine Region lies across Azurine Lake from Reborn City!
Full of beaches and mountains, it's quite an empty place, speaking in terms of the locals. In fact, there's only one settlement there!
On the Apophyll Beach, there is a small Academy!  Sometimes Trainers who wish not to study in the city will go there instead.
There is also an island not far off, known as Azurine Island. Little is known about it...
Finally, a massive volcano, known as Pyrous Mountain, towers above the area, shedding a layer of ash across it...
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Byxbysion Wasteland?
The Byxbysion Wasteland is a treacherous jumble of debris that surrounds the entire southern border of the Reborn Region.
Those who venture far out into it seldom return, so little is known about it...
But whispers of discovered ruins and objects suggest perhaps there was once something else beneath the filth...
Something from a story since passed and forgotten...  Orre it could simply be a rumor...
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Aventurine Region?
The Aventurine Region lies just north of here, through the Grand Gates!
On the whole, it's one of the most beautiful places in Reborn, with lush forests, rich peaks, and even a special crystal valley...
Also around are the Celestinine River, the famous Agate Circus, and Agate City with a history older than it belies... As well as a mysterious castle...
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Tourmaline Desert?
The Tourmaline Desert reaches for miles, bordering the northern end of the Reborn Region!
Many newcomers travel via train across the desert from very far away. What those Trainers don't know is the desert's mysterious history!
The train tracks have had to been rebuilt several times, thanks to a multitude of strange accidents...
As a result, a strange scrapyard of train parts rests out in the middle of the desert...
Sometimes, it even stands in the shadow of an enormous tower... But as soon as you blink- the tower vanishes! How curious...
Hello! Would you like to hear about the Carnelia Region?
The Carnelia Region is home to the twin cities of Calcenon and Labradorra! They rest in the valley of some of the tallest mountains in Reborn!
Though all topped with icy peaks, the largest by far is Ametrine Mountain! It overshadows even the most important Charous Mountain...
